neighbours.label: the conditional modal 'would' after a subject in expository prose ('patients would ...', 'it would appear'), as against the same sentences with 'will', 'can' or a plain verb
fire: Economists argue that a higher tax would slow the housing market.
Without the bridge, the trip would take most of the afternoon.
Most voters said they would support the new school budget.
At that price, it would seem the company is losing money.
Engineers warned that the dam would fail under heavy rain.
Critics claim the change would hurt small farmers most.
In that case the reaction would produce far less heat.
Her lawyer said she would appeal the ruling next month.
